correctness.rationale: For the deleted matching graph K_{n,n}−M_n, two omitted same-side vertices have equal selected-neighborhood traces iff both their matched partners are omitted; this is exactly |I∩J|>1, with separate one-selected-neighbor domination obstructions. The index-state generating function (xy+x+y)^n plus one double omission term minus explicitly disjoint boundary obstructions yields the bivariate displayed polynomial. Minimum n−1 follows from |I∪J|+|I∩J|≤n+1 with feasible p=3..n−2; counts n(2^(n−1)−2n), total (n+3)3^(n−1)−2n(n+1). Independently tested every labeled subset for n=4..7, obtaining totals 149,588,2103,7178 and minima 4,4,5,6; n=4 boundary correctly excluded from n−1 claim.
